items.prompt: Which critical section preserves the inventory invariant?

options.text: Lock only when printing the final result
options.why: That does not protect worker shared checks/updates.

options.text: Give every worker a different mutex around the same fields
options.why: Different locks do not exclude one another.

options.text: Lock the same mutex across availability check and both field updates
options.why: The compound transition and snapshots use one shared protocol.

options.text: Replace the fields with volatile int and remove locks
options.why: volatile is not standard inter-thread synchronization.

items.explanation: The entire shared invariant transition needs one agreed synchronization protocol.
